parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.778 indicates structural overlap, `stopTransitionsToIdle` (line 71) and `isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) are distinct behavioral assertions about the `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests` suite — one verifies a state transition to idle, the other verifies a boolean flag — and their near-duplicate shape is a natural consequence of the arrange-act-assert test pattern rather than accidental duplication. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated assertions. The restraint marker `is_test: true` on every member dominates any action signal here.
